technical-summary: Component tests compiled with -DNDEBUG (Radiance plugin module defaults CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE to RelWithDebInfo), so assert() checks were no-ops. Test targets now build with -UNDEBUG and assert-based tests refuse to build under NDEBUG. Two latent failures fixed: the duplicate-record test now exercises the duplicate path, and calibration ingest requires the plan-store key (no silent store under the helper key).
user-summary-candidate: Radiance serving and helper tests now actually run their checks; two hidden test gaps were fixed.
